title: Vintage Cousances Crêpière en Fonte – Made in France – Groupe Le Creuset
description:
Beautiful vintage Cousances cast iron crêpière / pancake pan, made in France and part of the historic Le Creuset group. A rare and timeless piece, ideal for crêpes, galettes, pancakes or traditional cooking on all heat sources.
This large model measures approximately 30 cm in diameter and features a very nice matte black patina with a minimalist vintage look. Heavy quality cast iron ensures excellent heat distribution and retention for perfect cooking results.
Marked “Cousances – Made in France” on the underside.
Good vintage condition with normal signs of age and use consistent with vintage cookware. Please see photos for details.
A wonderful collectible and practical kitchen piece for lovers of vintage French cast iron cookware, Le Creuset, Cousances and traditional French cuisine.
